agreed_facts.text: President Trump has struck a deal with Russia under Vladimir Putin that eases sanctions to allow purchases of Russian diesel.
A bipartisan group of senators criticised the deal and urged its reversal, saying it helps Moscow or betrays Ukraine.
The deal has drawn criticism from Ukraine and from US allies abroad, including Italy's prime minister Giorgia Meloni.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky accused Trump of betraying Ukraine or choosing the wrong side with the diesel deal.
Zelensky said Ukraine is losing the United States as a partner.
